summary: audit_readability caps_runs denominated per line — reflow changes the denominator, before/after deltas mislead
description: User-reported from the cleanup deck: gnostic-john-baptizer-1.012 shows audit score 13.4 -> 13.8 on a strictly-better rewrite (43 -> 11 lines, hard_wrap 0.21 -> 0.00, words preserved). caps_runs = caps_lines / n_lines, so unwrapping shrinks the denominator and the same caps headers quadruple the rate (0.23 -> 0.91, +6.8 weighted vs hard_wrap's -6.3). Coupling a signal's denominator to line count is wrong when line-wrapping is itself a damage class. Fix: denominate caps_runs per 1,000 chars (like page_marks/footnotes) so it is reflow-invariant; regenerate the audit table in docs/summary/readability-audit.md; refresh justification strings on pending staged_cleanups rows (cosmetic, no status/review changes).

resolution.note: caps_runs per kchar; deck deltas now honest; doc + pending justifications refreshed
